name: temper
description: Claude cannot write code before you approve the intent. Phase gates for AI written code: plan with blast radius, TDD, scored review, and gate verdicts computed by an auditable CLI that blocks git commit while a gate is red. With Claude Code 2.1.287 or later a mod refuses out of phase writes and draws a phase bar.

uiMode.title: Temper UI mode
uiMode.description: How much Temper draws: full, minimal or off. Denials and slash subcommands work in every mode.

enforcement.title: Temper enforcement
enforcement.description: on refuses out-of-phase writes and early commits; off keeps the UI only. Values: on or off.

fixMaxLoops.title: Fix loop limit
fixMaxLoops.description: Failed Check to Fix loops before Temper stops and offers re-plan, override or hand over.

prAttribution.title: Pull request attribution
prAttribution.description: on adds one Temper line to generated pull request descriptions. Values: on or off.

phaseModels.title: Per-phase models
phaseModels.description: Optional. Comma separated phase=model pairs such as build=sonnet. Empty means no change.

reviewerModel.title: Reviewer model
reviewerModel.description: Optional model for the Temper review agent. Empty means no change.

game.title: Game
game.description: Temper Merge game. on offers it while Claude works (key 8) and answers /temper:temper play. command answers the command only and offers nothing. off hides it all. Values: on, command or off.
